readme:
# Slickdeals Deal API

Fetch one Slickdeals deal by URL and get title, price, list price, store, coupon code, score, views, comments, and description in one normalized response.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "slickdeals/deal", "url": "https://slickdeals.net/f/20177112-lg-55-c6-series-oled-evo-ai-4k-smart-webos-tv-2026-best-buy-amazon-999-99"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. Lookups that find nothing fail with a not-found error.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | Yes | Slickdeals deal page URL, e.g. https://slickdeals.net/f/20177112-lg-55-c6-series-oled-evo-ai-4k-smart-webos-tv-2026-best-buy-amazon-999-99. |

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.00213 per request. A call can cost more when the first data source fails and another one answers. Failed calls and lookups that find nothing are not charged.
